lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har jan karanee ootam hai har keerat jag bisathaar ||3||
lines.translation: The lifestyle of the Lord's humble servant is exalted and sublime. He spreads the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises throughout the world. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar thaakur mere har har har ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, please be merciful, merciful to me, that I may enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, Har, within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur pooraa paaiaa man japiaa naam muraar ||4||9||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the Perfect True Guru; in his mind, he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||9||
Malaar, Third Mehl, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man girahee k ihu man udaasee ||
lines.translation: Is this mind a householder, or is this mind a detached renunciate?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਰਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: k ihu man avaran sadaa avinaasee ||
lines.translation: Is this mind beyond social class, eternal and unchanging?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: k ihu man cha(n)chal k ihu man bairaagee ||
lines.translation: Is this mind fickle, or is this mind detached?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: is man kau mamataa kithahu laagee ||1||
lines.translation: How has this mind been gripped by possessiveness? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit is man kaa karahu beechaar ||
lines.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, reflect on this in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar k bahutaa paRahi uthaavahi bhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Why do you read so many other things, and carry such a heavy load? ||1||Pause||
The Creator has attached it to Maya and possessiveness.
Enforcing His Order, He created the world.
By Guru's Grace, understand this, O Siblings of Destiny.
Remain forever in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਪੰਡ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so pa(n)dit jo tihaa(n) gunaa kee pa(n)d utaarai ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Pandit, who sheds the load of the three qualities.
Night and day, he chants the Name of the One Lord.
He accepts the Teachings of the True Guru.
He offers his head to the True Guru.
He remains forever unattached in the state of Nirvaanaa.
Such a Pandit is accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
He preaches that the One Lord is within all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) eko vekhai taa(n) eko jaanai ||
lines.translation: As he sees the One Lord, he knows the One Lord.
That person, whom the Lord forgives, is united with Him.
He finds eternal peace, here and hereafter. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak kavan bidh kare kiaa koi ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, what can anyone do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee mukat jaa kau kirapaa hoi ||
lines.translation: He alone is liberated, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.
Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saasatr bed kee phir kook na hoi ||5||1||10||
lines.translation: Then, he no longer bothers with the proclamations of the Shaastras or the Vedas. ||5||1||10||
Malaar, Third Mehl:
The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in reincarnation, confused and deluded by doubt.
The Messenger of Death constantly beats them and disgraces them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevaa jam kee kaan chukaaee ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mortal's subservience to Death is ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh miliaa mahal ghar paaee ||1||
lines.translation: He meets the Lord God, and enters the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||
O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath dubidhaa khoiaa kaudee badalai jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In duality, you are ruining and wasting this priceless human life. You trade it away in exchange for a shell. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh falls in love with the Lord, by His Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar bhagat har har ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: He enshrines loving devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, deep within his heart.
The Word of the Shabad carries him across the terrifying world-ocean.
He appears true in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu karam kare satigur nahee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Performing all sorts of rituals, they do not find the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur bharam bhoole bahu maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, so many wander lost and confused in Maya.
Egotism, possessiveness and attachment rise up and increase within them.
In the love of dualty, the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||
The Creator Himself is Inaccessible and Infinite.
Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and earn the true profit.
The Lord is Independent, Ever-present, here and now.
